description:
Activate Ulvenwald Abomination by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Ulvenwald Abomination.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

uses.name: Ulvenwald Captive // Ulvenwald Abomination
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Ulvenwald Abomination and without summoning sickness
